text.p: Flood crests have passed Grand Forks and Fargo in North Dakota, USA. Flooding will be very slow to recede in those areas, however. The flood crest is now moving toward Canada and is expected to arrive in the Winnepeg area early next week. No major storminess is expected in the region the next 3-5 days.

Tropical Storm Jimmy, with 55 mph winds, is in the western Pacific near 21n/156e, moving north northeast at 7 mph. It will turn back to the northeast, weaken, and dissipate in about 48 hours. It is only a threat to shipping, but not to land.
There are no further statements at this time.
